claim_ceiling: The public paint-removal transform clarifies the already known f2r.15 note but does not resolve its ink/paint order, and it does not turn f99v.45 into a stable character sequence. Algorithmic paint suppression is not physical layer evidence. These two witnesses supply no character value, colour gloss, word, sound, language, cipher, plaintext, meaning, or translation.

targets.observation: The processing suppresses much of the leaf wash and makes the already transcribed three-group note easier to see at the bottom-right leaf. It exposes no additional group or second state and cannot determine whether the ink preceded the paint; the ordinary-light boundary-overlap correction remains controlling.

On the dark three-tuber plant the alleged west-tuber trace remains diffuse tonal variation without a stable character count or segmentation. The transform does not authenticate it as writing or distinguish ink from pigment variation abrasion parchment texture or a processing artefact.
